note: NC pi0 production on argon (per nucleon), Fermilab BNB. Flux-averaged differential cross sections in pi0 momentum and cos(theta_pi0), split by hadronic final state (0 protons / N protons / any protons Xp). The release also ships an Xp double-differential [cos(theta_pi0), P_pi0] (24 bins) which is not ingested here. Values + the cross-observable total covariance (Wiener-SVD) from the arXiv ancillary release.
